name: Standalone headset (Android-based), 72 fps
basis: OpenGL ES 3.2 includes ASTC LDR textures in its core (Khronos OpenGL ES 3.2 specification); Vulkan devices of this class report textureCompressionASTC_LDR. 72 Hz is the lowest refresh rate standalone headsets of this class run at, and the frame rate must hold for both eyes. Texture formats are a common choice (ASTC 6x6 colour, 4x4 normal maps), not a vendor rule. Budgets are left unset: a team sets its own in its own profile.
